_readme: Known files over the 500-line convention (claudedocs/server.md, '单文件 500 行收敛' — tools/ adopted the same rule 2026-08-13, G4). Paths below are relative to tools/ (the --root passed to the shared scripts/checkFileLength.mjs). Schema: { "path": { "lines": <number>, "reason": "<why this is a justified exception>" } }. checkFileLength.mjs fails CI only if a file NOT listed here crosses 500 lines, a listed file grows past the line count recorded here, or an entry has no 'reason' or exceeds the 800-line hard cap. Currently EMPTY: the last entry (level-editor/src/board/BoardPanel.ts, 543 lines) was retired 2026-08-20 when ADR-070 Phase 4b moved that panel's pure layer out to src/layout/board.ts and the file fell to 430 lines.
